declared_build_goals:
1. W1 — Payment security: one capped pull primitive closing the MAX_PAY bypass on all pay lanes, compute-ratio cap so creators are never starved by 1-wei splits, verifier NFT-caller gate + one-shot ProofUsed, iData size caps.
2. W2 — Signature settlement: Permit2 witness settlement (payForAgentWithPermit2), DelegationRegistry with per-tx/windowed spend caps and mandatory Merkle selector roots, StateView facade with Multicall3 batch reads.
3. W3 — Ship V3 to testnet: fresh Galileo deploy of the full V3 suite with in-script wiring assertions; backend, frontend, and ABIs re-pointed.
4. W4 — Shrink the contract surface: StateView folded into the Processor (6 to 5 contracts), storage layout proven with forge inspect diffs, proxy upgraded live.
5. W5 — Gasless users: AxiomGasTank with lazy 0.01 OG grants, off-chain relayer (EIP-712, simulation, rate gates, dead-lettering), chat sponsor lane, frontend tank UX, so a user with zero ETH can act.
6. W6 — Make it DeFi: constant-product pool, LP shares, lending inside the PaymentProcessor, axmWETH mock, 1,000-axmUSDC faucet, Pyth price endpoint — zero new contracts.
7. W7–W9 — Prove it: mainnet-switch prep with browser E2E of the gasless journey, canonical EIP-712 digest fix found by that E2E and redeployed, sponsored DeFi chat tools behind a calldata gate.
product_category_justification: The agent itself is the product (ERC-7857 iNFT with gasless chat tools), the swap/lend treasury is the DeFi surface, and the GasTank/relayer is 0G infrastructure any other builder can adopt — all three are live, so the pick costs nothing in honesty.
updates_in_this_wave:
Axiom Protocol is a mainnet-ready, gasless agent infrastructure built on 0G: an ERC-7857 agent marketplace where a wallet with zero gas claims a 0.01 OG grant, pays agents, swaps, borrows, and delegates — every step verified by an on-chain end-to-end run.

Architecture (9 executed engineering waves):
- AxiomGasTank: lazy 0.01 OG grants, per-user nonces, ERC-1271 dual-path signing, relayer reimbursement clamped three ways, solvency invariant fuzz-verified over 257 runs.
- ERC-2771 retrofit of AgentNFT and PaymentProcessor via UUPS; relayer with EIP-712 recovery, eth_call simulation, rate gating, dead-lettering.
- Swap pool, LP shares, collateralized lending inside the PaymentProcessor — DeFi rails with zero extra contracts.
- Sponsored chat tools: pay, withdraw, swap_tokens, borrow run gas-free behind a server-side DeFi calldata gate (selector, target, pool-token checks).
- Canonical EIP-712 digest hardening: our browser E2E caught a signature-verification drift on the live tank; fixed, redeployed, digest parity verified on-chain, permanent drift-guard test added.
- Permit2 witness settlement, DelegationRegistry with Merkle selector roots, and a gated mainnet deployment script (7 pre-broadcast safety gates); 0G's deployed Permit2 verified byte-identical to upstream.

Evidence: 907 tests green (forge 343/0, backend 249, chat-runtime 100, config 62, frontend 153); 699 public commits. Live contracts on 0G: AgentNFT 0xe32f87C6F8070C89a82D51BDd3fab578C0d7be6f, Processor 0xe6956f663103c6E1e5077c3256c453b95924112a, Vault 0xe8B3B31E5CE0436cCfD19a47351943CcB7703722, TeeVerifier 0x4938F10B12051CE8DCd70E3F7555E71adb432545, GasTank 0xF19245876Cd6Cb115810D459B00e94130591CAaa, DelegationRegistry 0xeA411cC163CAab2678E3E40dF3C1622EB28CCD58. Live app: https://axiom-protocol.vercel.app · Code: https://github.com/symulacr/axiom-protocol

0G primitives: 0G Chain (settlement, gasless relay), 0G Storage (encrypted agent payloads, chat transcripts, sealed-DEK custody), 0G Compute (inference), Permit2, Pyth prices. DA evaluated and declined with reasons (ADR-002).

Mainnet posture: DeployAristotle deploys and wires all seven instances behind 7 safety gates — one command cut overs the full suite; paymentToken is admin-swappable to canonical USDC.e; grants default off on mainnet; default network is mainnet.
fourth_wave_milestone: Default network is Aristotle mainnet (16661): the gated one-command deployment (DeployAristotle.s.sol, 7 safety gates, already simulated) cut overs all contract instances and env, and the proof-of-success is a judge connecting any wallet at the demo URL and completing a gas-free agent payment directly on mainnet.
fifth_wave:
1. Mainnet execution. Run DeployAristotle.s.sol on 16661 — deploys and wires all seven instances behind the 7 pre-broadcast safety gates (non-zero pay cap, real swap pair, grants opt-in only, admin wiring under the second oracle-admin broadcast, post-broadcast assertion wall). Env cutover per ADR-004 ordering.
2. Relayer funding + public demo. Fund the relayer EOA to >=0.5 OG (~800 sponsored ops at 0.0006 OG/op) and record one replayable mainnet session: fresh wallet claims grant, sponsored swap + borrow, every op carrying a Relayed tx hash.
3. Relayer durability. Persist the sponsorship queue behind the EventStore; deadline-bounded signatures already allow re-submission.
4. Lending v2. External Pyth price for LP collateral valuation, interest accrual, liquidation path.
5. Ops: owner sweep helper for the retired tank (0.1 OG) and an off-chain alarm on swapSolvency() so pool solvency is monitored continuously.
6. Params behind the live 10-minute timelock: swap fee, borrow factor, grants; delegation card wired to the DelegationRegistry in the same cutover.
